title: Learning with Local Search MCMC Layers
abstract: arXiv:2505.14240v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Integrating combinatorial optimization layers into neural networks has recently attracted significant research interest. However, many existing approaches lack theoretical guarantees or fail to perform adequately when relying on inexact solvers. This is a critical limitation, as many operations research problems are NP-hard, often necessitating the use of neighborhood-based local search heuristics. In this paper, we introduce a principled approach for learning with such inexact solvers. Inspired by the connection between simulated annealing and Metropolis-Hastings, we transform the problem specific neighborhood systems used in local search heuristics into proposal distributions, implementing MCMC on the set of feasible solutions. This allows us to construct differentiable, stochastic combinatorial layers and associated loss functions. Replacing an exact solver with a local search strongly reduces the computational burden of learning

translated_title: 基于局部搜索MCMC层的学习
translated_abstract: 将组合优化层集成到神经网络中近来引起了广泛的研究兴趣。然而，许多现有方法缺乏理论保证，或者在使用不精确求解器时表现不佳。这是一个关键的限制，因为许多运筹学问题是NP难的，通常需要使用基于邻域的局部搜索启发式算法。在本文中，我们提出了一种使用此类不精确求解器进行学习的原则性方法。受模拟退火与Metropolis-Hastings之间联系的启发，我们将局部搜索启发式算法中针对具体问题的邻域系统转化为提议分布，从而在可行解集合上实现MCMC（马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛）。这使我们能够构建可微的、随机性的组合层以及相应的损失函数。用局部搜索替代精确求解器，极大地降低了学习的计算负担。
tldr: 受模拟退火与Metropolis-Hastings联系的启发，论文将局部搜索启发式算法的邻域系统转化为提议分布，构建出可微的随机MCMC组合层及对应损失函数，为使用不精确求解器的组合优化层学习提供了理论基础，并显著降低了计算成本。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the connection between simulated annealing and Metropolis-Hastings, the paper transforms local search neighborhood systems into proposal distributions to build differentiable stochastic MCMC combinatorial layers with theoretical guarantees, substantially reducing the computational burden of learning with inexact solvers.
